item.tib: ma rgyud rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sbyin sreg nyi ma 'bum 'od gsal ba'i me dpung 'bar ba
item.coloph: e ltar gsang sngags gsang mchog mthar thug pa'i/ ma rgyud rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs la/ mchod pa sbyin sreg nyi ma 'bum 'od gsal ba'i me dpung 'bar ba zhes bya ba / g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa'i don ched du/ dmu rigs nyi ma'i ming can gyis/ byang gi sa gnas stong rgyung gi gser rdo sgang chen zhes bya bar brtsams pa/ dar zhing rgyas nas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan chen po mdzad du gsol/ shig phag zla ba lnga pa'i nyer gcig la mdzad pa dge legs 'phel//
